title: Update the way that the maximum vector dimension is configured.

timeline.message:
Update the way that the maximum vector dimension is configured.

The maximum supported dimension used to be configured on the FieldType, it's
now on the codec.
timeline.author: Adrien Grand

timeline.body:
The maximum supported dimension used to be configured on the FieldType, it's now on the codec.

Closes #98747.

In 8.11 (or 8.12), we want to increase MAX_DIMS_COUNT to 4096.  Will we need to create a new KnnVectorsFormat for that?

If an index was created in 8.10 where MAX_DIMS_COUNT to 2048, and then later (say in 8.12) wants to add a new knn field with dims > 2048 (where it will be allowed), should we allow it?

reply.body: No need to create a new format, we can simply bump the constant from 2048 to 4096. I think we should allow existing indexes to have more than 2048 dimensions too indeed.

timeline.body:
@jpountz Thanks Adrien, this looks great to me.

I just left a question to clarify what should be our strategy when we want to update `MAX_DIMS_COUNT`?
Thanks Mayya! I think we should simply bump the constant if we want to increase the limit?
